key_idea: Treating the Hölder exponent as a small parameter ($\alpha \to 0$) to localize the non-local Biot-Savart law, reducing the leading-order dynamics to a 'fundamental model' with explicit self-similar blow-up.
reason: The proof features a brilliantly unexpected conceptual core that clearly explains why the blow-up must occur. However, rigorously controlling the full 3D Euler equations as a perturbation of this model requires a heavy, intricate apparatus of tailored weighted Sobolev spaces and dense energy estimates.
recognized: Elgindi, Finite-time singularity formation for C^{1,alpha} solutions to the incompressible Euler equations on R^3 (2021)
